detail.longDescription: Spending my Sunday watching # VisionQuest and porting over my web-editor stacks in # Portainer to compose files in a repo so they can be versioned etc Should have done it a loooooong time ago, but it was one of those "if it ain't broke, don't fix it" things until I found myself annoyed I didn't have a previous config for something I was running I'm also taking this opportunity to pin things to versions rather than just latest # HomeLab # SelfHosting # SelfHosted
